narr: Early morning thunderstorms produced heavy rainfall across portions of the forecast area prompting the issuance of Flood Advisories and a Flash Flood Warning in the Columbia Metro area.
ev: Minor flooding occurred at the intersection of Whaley Street and Main Street due to flooding of Rocky Branch Creek. A total of 1.0 to 1.5 inches of rain fell in less than 1 hour.
